documents.title: Northwind invoice whose VAT is not 7% of its own subtotal
documents.demonstrates: The page states 7%, a subtotal of 38,000.00 and tax of 3,420.00. Seven percent of 38,000 is 2,660. The document contradicts itself, and no lookup is needed to know it - the arithmetic is recomputed rather than read.

documents.title: ใบกำกับภาษี — ไทยพัฒนา วิศวกรรม
documents.demonstrates: Thai labels, a Buddhist-era date, and nothing wrong with it. This is the case that fails quietly when it fails: the digits are Arabic and come back from OCR perfectly, so the only question is whether anything understood that จำนวนเงินทั้งสิ้น is the total and that 2569 is 2026.

documents.title: Siam Tech invoice billing more than PO-2026-9101 allows
documents.demonstrates: The invoice adds up, the vendor is registered and the bank account is right. It bills 168,000.00 against a purchase order for 135,000.00. Nothing on the page is wrong; the defect only exists once the order has been fetched and the two numbers compared, which is the one check here that needs an agent rather than a condition.
